subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------CULT.INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 358 (PMBA-22). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the subject; CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), C-CONT (composite continuance) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From TR: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: INFO-INTG (information integration). From C-CONT: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: PART (participation). From VT-DY: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-BS: APL-DT (application dictates).
